title: Sustainability, versioning + license-reverification cadence plan
context: After the benchmark is released and adopted, it must remain trustworthy over time: per-collection licenses can change, upstream archives can withdraw collections, and new versions of the benchmark must be versioned and DOI-able. A named maintenance rotation, a versioning scheme, a license re-verification cadence, and a steward relationship must all be documented. This plan is the M4 sustainability gate. See PLAN.md (Sustainability & maintenance, License-reverification cadence).
objective: Author a sustainability, versioning, and license-reverification cadence plan covering: (1) the maintenance rotation (who owns the harness, gate, and CI); (2) the release versioning scheme (semver, DOI-per-version, per-release license/provenance snapshot); (3) the license re-verification cadence (schedule for re-checking per-collection terms; what to do if a collection is withdrawn or re-licensed); (4) the steward relationship (who owns the adopter relationship and reuse tracking); (5) how breadth (new collections/tasks) follows a documented, gated process only after the first task/release is stable.
acceptanceCriteria: A named maintenance rotation is documented: who owns the harness, gate, and CI, with a succession/fallback noted.
The release versioning scheme is defined: semantic versioning, DOI-per-version, and a per-release license/provenance snapshot (retrieval dates, checksums, per-collection license at time of release).

A license re-verification cadence is specified: the schedule (e.g. annual or per-release), the trigger for out-of-cycle re-verification (collection withdrawn or re-licensed), and the process for handling a license change (update allow-list, quarantine affected artifacts, notify adopters).
The steward relationship is documented: who owns the adopter relationship and reuse/citation tracking.
A gated process for adding new collections or tasks (breadth) is defined, requiring the same license + de-id + domain-reviewer gates.
The sustainability plan is committed via PR (e.g. docs/sustainability.md).
output: A sustainability, versioning, and license-reverification cadence plan document (committed via PR) defining maintenance rotation, versioning scheme, re-verification schedule, steward relationship, and breadth-expansion gating.
